title: MED+250 pharmacy marketplace operations procedure approval
summary: Owner-ready approval record for the implemented pharmacy-only, information-first operating procedure. Technical behavior is documented, but named staffing, operational acceptance and signature remain the responsibility of the MED+250 operations lead.

checks.name: Pharmacy-only information marketplace model
checks.detail: The procedure states that only pharmacies participate, catalogue products and optional From-RWF values remain central, pharmacy stock and pharmacy-specific public price lists are unsupported, and an order is optional after WhatsApp reconfirmation.

checks.name: Dispatch and national fallback procedure
checks.detail: The procedure matches the current routing contract: verified nearby pharmacies are prioritized, at most 20 eligible responders receive a request, and unverified proximity is presented only as national service coverage.

checks.name: Availability confirmation and price boundaries
checks.detail: The procedure requires item-by-item availability, governed substitutes, optional private non-final pharmacy estimates, and reconfirmation of final price and fulfilment on WhatsApp.

checks.name: Selection, prescription, cancellation and expiry
checks.detail: The procedure preserves pre-selection privacy, the two-hour availability window, the 24-hour selected-pharmacy access window, customer-controlled closure and the implemented prescription-retention boundaries.

checks.name: Contact, location and incident governance
checks.detail: The procedure requires single-record contact and location review, prohibits inferred WhatsApp or GPS approval, and defines identity, privacy, routing, regulatory and outage incident actions.

checks.name: Named production staff assignments
checks.detail: The operations lead has not yet recorded the named operations, pharmacy review, support, security, privacy and regulatory escalation contacts in the controlled staff register.

checks.name: Operational acceptance and signature
checks.detail: The operations lead must review the procedure against the intended production pharmacy set, confirm it is operationally usable, record conditions if any, and sign this artifact.

completion_instructions: Assign named people to every accountable role in the controlled staff register and test the escalation channels.
Review the procedure against the intended production pharmacy set and record any approved conditions or limitations.
Confirm the procedure digest still matches docs/launch/PHARMACY_OPERATIONS_SOP.md.
Set every check to passed, set decision to approved, add the named approver, role and timezone-qualified timestamp, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed artifact strictly, record its SHA-256 digest in data/launch-evidence.json and confirm the gate only after the registry validates.
